_note: Creator/viral pass for the Lakewood + inner-ring expansion (Aug 2026). Vetting per docs/SOURCES.md: real following + real Cleveland-food beat + a findable piece of content. The 12 food + 11 sight records in this expansion already each carry >=2 credible EDITORIAL/INSTITUTIONAL sources, so they do not depend on a creator to clear the >=2 gate. Creators below are registered as reusable corroboration for the Cleveland food scene; per the honesty rule, no creator is ATTACHED to a specific named place because the shared WebSearch budget did not confirm a findable video/post AT one of these exact places. Vetted via Cleveland Scene's '19 Cleveland Food Influencers You Should Be Following' and WKYC coverage.

creators.name: Emily — Cleveland Food + Travel (@thingsivebeeneating)
creators.credible: Active Cleveland food+travel creator; ~93.9K TikTok followers (2.9M likes) and ~78K IG. Real, findable body of Cleveland/NE-Ohio restaurant content. City-scope.

creators.name: Joey Riccatone (@clevelandfood25)
creators.credible: Cleveland food creator (~50K IG) whose stated mission is spotlighting local small-business restaurants; profiled on-air by WKYC (Channel 3), a TV-news validation of following and beat. City-scope.

creators.name: Johansen — @thatswhatsheeats
creators.credible: Named in Cleveland Scene's '19 Cleveland Food Influencers You Should Be Following'; ~130K IG followers, sustained Cleveland restaurant beat. City-scope.

creators.name: Jane Schafer — @foodsofjane
creators.credible: Named in Cleveland Scene's food-influencer roundup; ~58K IG followers, ongoing Cleveland-area food content. City-scope.

rejected.reason: Huge TikTok following (~8M) but a voice-actor/comedy creator whose food posts are entertainment-first and not a verifiable Cleveland restaurant-review beat; a Lakewood clip exists but scope is general/region, not a city food authority. Not registered as a food-recommender source.
